item.title: Bigfoot, Dogman & Terrifying Cryptid Encounters (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Bryan M. Bowden is an internationally recognized paranormal researcher, author, broadcaster, and investigator who has spent nearly five decades exploring the mysteries of Bigfoot, Dogman, UFOs, cryptids, hauntings, and human consciousness. A native of New York City and graduate of Pace University, Bryan transitioned from a successful career in international finance to pursue his lifelong passion for the unexplained. An active field investigator since 1977, he has appeared on the Travel Channel, Discovery+, UFO Witness, Spaced Out Radio, and numerous documentaries and podcasts. As the creator and host of Third Eye Live, Bryan interviews leading researchers and experiencers while investigating paranormal activity, remote viewing, psychic phenomena, and UFO disclosure. Known to many as Sir Bryan, he continues to push the boundaries of conventional understanding in his search for answers to the world's greatest mysteries.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
